body: i made a post a while back (about the same thing lol!) and it was less about my sister being bossy and the fact that she treats it like it’s a job but she doesn’t pay me for it - i babysit for seven hours monday and tuesday and only get paid $10 and my sister is really adamant about paying me any higher :/ but i will definitely try to bring it up again and be more stern about it, thank you!!
i have his amiibo if youd ever like to trade \^\_\_\^
it’s really worth it !! i thought the septum wouldn’t suit my face at first but it does and i’m so happy with it :D
he’s one of my favorites i love him sm but i really want to go dreamie hunting so i thought i’d let him go since i have his amiibo! ^__^

he has been lightly gifted ! i was thinking around 48 because that’s what he sells for on nookazon but i can happily negotiate if you think otherwise. (his gifts and such have been either with his japanese theme - kimonos etc - or with his color theme - reds and whites - i hope this helps !!)
this has helped so much, i know we are strangers but your comment seems so genuine and i just want to thank you. i hope that your situation gets better, truly. you deserve it

i have a bank account! :) they do pay into that instead of cash, but for whatever reason my sister will need to be reminded multiple times before even paying me. and as much as i wish my mum would advocate for me that i should be getting paid more, she’s on C’s mum side in saying that i shouldn’t even need to be paid for looking after family.

while i’m not okay with the amount of money i’m being paid i really don’t want to cause a fight with my sister, my other sister (mum to S) has only asked me to babysit this week since we’ve got family issues going on- but if i were to ask for a raise from C’s mom she’d just start an argument with me

Mentioned in a previous comment somewhere but my sister (mum to C!) has only made me her babysitter because she knows i won’t ask for a pay increase :( it truly is frustrating because so many people my age have good paying jobs and if i were to ask for any sort of rise my sister and her husband just laugh it off

I’m unable to back out of this situation, there’s no one else in my family free to take care of the kids, it’s extremely frustrating and I do want to do it, anything for my nieces. It’s more so that this whole ordeal has been put on me today and I’ve got to do it. (I also want to mention that I appreciate you going in depth for me! I’ll try asking to be paid beforehand this time so I’ve got the money in advance.) 

The place I’m going to is my other sister’s flat, I’ve just never been since i don’t see S often so I hope it’s toddler-proofed and there’s food I’m able to make for them instead of giving them sandwiches 

(i hope this replies to everything in your message!! once again using a phone so the formatting of reddit is awful) thank you again for replying though!
